Commentary.Commentary: And there comes the declaration. Kohli waits for Karun Nair to complete his triple ton and then calls them back. What a knock, what a player, what a time, to do it for his team. He stood there long and hard, applied himself out there and never for a moment he looked in trouble. He found partners in Rahul, Vijay, Ashwin and then Jadeja. He kept on stitching valuable stands with them and helped his side post such a mammoth total on the board. So, India have a lead of 282 runs and will come out to bowl 5 overs to England. The visitors after having a hard day on the field will first look to see off those allotted overs. Will they be able to do so? Or will the Indians sneak in one? To know, join us in a bit for the entertaining end to this day...

FOUR! A SPECTACLE IT HAS BEEN! Gets the crowd and everyone behind him. What a moment, first a ton, then a double ton and now a triple ton, simply outstanding. Only the second Indian to achieve this feat. Coming to the ball, it was short and outside off, turns away a bit, Nair pounces on it as he gets back and cuts it towards cover-point. Captain Cook misfields and the ball races away to the fence. The young man sinks the acknowledgment that is on offer as INDIA DECLARE ON 759/7, LEAD BY 282!
Tossed outside off, Karun sits down and tries to sweep it but is unable to make contact and the ball hits on his pads.
Yadav looks to cut this short ball but gets it off the outer part of the bat through point. It doesn't matter as he brings Nair on strike.
Doosra from outside off, Umesh Yadav has no idea about it and the ball hits his pads.
Pitched way down the leg side, Karun tries to paddle it but is unable to make contact.
UMESH YADAV is the new man in, replacing Jadeja!

OUT! THROWN IT AWAY! Tossed up outside off, Jadeja goes to heave it over mid-wicket but the ball falls in the hands of the fielder at wide long on who had to cover a fair distance. Jake Ball pockets it easily and Jadeja has to go back after a really quick fire half century. And that brings Karun on strike as they crossed during the catch.
Dragged short outside off, Nair cuts it through point for a single.
Outside leg, Karun tries to flick but he misses and the ball hits his back pad.
Angling into the stumps, Jadeja pushes it towards long on for a single.
Pitched up and Karun nudges it towards square leg for a single. A second was denied by Karun.
LIAM DAWSON comes in for a bowl.
Jadeja stays in line of the ball to defend it.
Dragged short, Nair works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Nair tries to drive it but is beaten by the spin.
4th Test fifty for Ravindra Jadeja!
On the pads, Jadeja nudges it towards short fine leg for a single. He gets to his fifty with it at a really quick pace. Once he reaches there, we get to watch the Rajput celebration in style.
Tossed up, Karun chips it in the air towards long on for a single. That was scary for a moment.
Tossed outside off, Jadeja cuts it through point for a single.
Halftracker on middle, Jadeja camps back and pulls it in front of square for a single.
Floats it up around middle, Nair comes down the track and just nudges it towards square leg. He was desperate to get back for another one but won't be able to.
Short outside off, cut through point for just a single.
Comes forward and blocks it out.
Short and outside off, Jadeja goes back as the ball stays low but still cuts it through covers and comes back for a couple. Good running between the wickets, this.

SIX! Jadeja getting into the act as well! He says enough of watching the hitting from Nair, I can do it as well. Tossed up ball around off, Jadeja skips down the track and smacks it back over long off for a maximum.
FOUR! PIERCED SQUARE LEG AND MID-WICKET! A short ball and Karun pounces on it to pull it through the gaps for a boundary. Inching closer and closer to glory.
Again a reverse sweep but this time straight to the point fielder.
Outside off, Karun plays it late towards point and a misfield from Root results in a couple.
FOUR! SUBLIME ! Tossed outside off, Karun moves a bit away and sways it through the cover region for a boundary. Pierces all the gaps.
Another reverse sweep through point for a couple.
Tossed outside leg, Karun moves away and plays it inside out over covers for a couple.
Loopy ball around off, it shoots up and hits him on the glove. There is an overthrow and Jadeja scampers to keep Nair on strike.
Comes down the track to flick but the ball turns in and he gets hit on the pads.
Full on middle, Jadeja eases it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Flatter one on middle, Nair gets down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket. He wanted another one but won't get it.
Gets it this time, outside off, reverse swept behind point for a couple.
Full and outside off, Nair looks to reverse sweep it but fails to get a connection here.
Full on off, eased down to long off for a single.

FOUR! More runs! They are coming and so is Karun's triple ton, folks! Rashid once again bowls a floated ball around off, Nair gets down on one knee and brings out the sweep. Makes another terrific connection and gets the crowd going.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
FOUR! NAIR ON FIRE! Tossed up around middle, it's in the slot as well. Karun gets down and sweeps it through mid-wicket. Picks the spot and nails it. Kohli is up to applaud for him.
SIX! He's picked the bones outta that one! Rashid drags his length short, Nair pounces on the offer. Goes back and pulls it with all timing over mid-wicket for a biggie all the way.
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, nudged towards square leg for one.
A change of bat for KARUN NAIR and also a message maybe.
Loopy ball around off, Jadeja comes forward to flick but gets a leading edge towards the off side for a single.
Drops it short and around off, punched off the back foot towards the off side for a single. 700 up for India!
Full around off, it's bunted back to the bowler.
SIX! Tonk! Tossed up delivery around middle and off, Karun Nair once agains skips down the track and goes bang over the long on fence for a biggie all the way. Hit that really well.
Loopy around off, Nair gets down the track again and hits it aerially over mid-wicket. Didn't time it well but collects a couple.
Loopy ball around middle, Nair comes down the track to go big but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards short mid-wicket.
Flatter one around middle, punched off the back foot again but for nothing.
Around middle and off, swept towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flicked through the on side for another single.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Punched towards long on for a single.
KARUN NAIR gets to his maiden 250+ score.

There it is! He is going strong and hard with every ball! The Chepauk crowd is up again, the Indian dressing room is doing the same. Not a big celebration from the young man, just another raise of a bat and sinks in the moment. Very full around middle. Nair comes forward and nurdles it towards square leg for one.
ADIL RASHID comes in for a bowl.
Another message comes out.
Loopy ball around off, Jadeja comes forward to drive but gets an outside edge past the vacant first slip and takes a couple.
Ali tosses it up around middle and leg, flicked towards square leg for another one. Moves to 249 now!
Full around middle, worked towards short mid-wicket for another single.
Short outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Full and darted in on off, Jadeja defends it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball around middle, nudged towards square leg for a single.
Bangs in short on middle, Jadeja ducks to let that sail over him to the keeper.
Landed outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Nair tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls a length ball on off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Touch short and outside off, cut straight to the man at point.
Fuller in length and angling outside off, Jadeja uses the pace as he glides it down to third man. Some brilliant fielding in the deep keeps them down to a couple.
There comes a message from the 12th man. Declaration batting is on cards?
Full and around middle, Nair looks to reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.

STUMPING CHANCE GOES DOWN ABEGGING! Karun Nair survives a scare here. He sees the flight and tries to get to 250 with a bang down the ground. Advances down the track but the ball spins in sharply and he gets beaten. Bairstow didn't expect that, as the ball beats him as well. It goes towards fine leg and the batsmen collect two byes.
Drops it short on off, Jadeja gets back and slaps it through cover-point for another one.
Darted on middle and leg, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Full and gripping through the surface, Nair looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early and gets a leading edge towards point for one.
Shortish length on off, it rises off the deck. Nair hops to fend it away but it goes off the handle of the bat towards the off side and they take a single.
Floodlights have been turned on now...
Leg bye! Strayed on the pads, Jadeja looks to flick but it goes off the pads towards fine leg. A leg bye is taken.
Very full and slanting it across the batsman, Jadeja tries to run it down with an opened face but fails to put bat on ball.
Fuller in length and curling back in, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Back of a length delivery outside off, tapped towards point for a quick single.
50-run stand between Nair and Jadeja!
Angles in a length ball on middle, tucked towards the leg side for a single. This is the highest team total at this venue now!
Drinks!
Dragged short, Jadeja punches it through covers for a single.
into his pads, Nair gets in line of the ball and flicks it off his pads for a single towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! INNOVATIVE ! Pitched outside off, Nair reverse paddles it through the slip cordon for a brilliant boundary. Seems like he owns that shot.
A bit short and Jadeja camps back and punches it towards mid on for a single.
Floated this time between middle and leg, Jadeja lunges forward and the ball hits his pads. Moeen appeals for LBW but it is turned down by the umpire.
Tossed up on the stumps, Jadeja prods forward to defend it.
MOEEN ALI comes in for a bowl.
Slower delivery outside off and Jadeja gets in line of the delivery to guide it down the third man for a single.
Length ball outside off, Karun cuts it through point for a single.
Outside off, Jadeja reaches out it too cut it through the point region for a single.
Slower full toss down the leg side, Jadeja tries to nudge it but is unable to make contact.
Length ball outside off, Nair drives it through the cover region for a single.
Angling into the stumps, Karun defends it well.
BEN STOKES comes in for a bowl.
FOUR! FLAT BATTED! Short again and Jadeja goes for a pull again this time between square leg and mid-wicket.
SIX! CLOBBERRED! Dug in short and Jadeja pulls it really hard towards square leg for a biggie. He is now taking the attack to the opposition.
Really short this time and the ball kept on climbing, Jadeja stays in his crease and he watches it sail over his head.
Length ball outside off, Karun drives it through the cover region for a single.
Angling into the body, karun moves across and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Dug in short again to Jadeja, he tries to pull it really hard but the ball finds the toe end of the bat and tickles through gully for a single.
Pitched outside off, Nair tries to flick it but he finds a leading edge towards covers.
FOUR! BRUTAL! Dug in short into the body, Karun stands tall and pulls it away towards mid on for a boundary. That was not well timed though but it tickled away to the ropes.
Pitched outside off and nipped in a bit, Nair tries to cut it towards point but is unable to make contact.
Back of a length on the body, Jadeja clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, Karun drives it through covers for a single.
Sliding across his body, Jadeja stands tall and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Again a short one into his body, Jadeja stands tall and nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Karun opens the face of his bat to push it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Pitched up and Nair gets in line of the ball to drive it towards mid on.
Back of a length delivery on the body again, Jadeja works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Again a short one into his body, the ball hits Jadeja's back while on its way to the keeper.

Short and wide outside off, Nair pushes it towards point for a single.
Fuller on off, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Stays behind the line and defends it with a straight bat.

Edged and dropped! Root the culprit! Ball comes steaming in and hurls a length ball in the channel outside off, Karun Nair plays a lazy drive and gets an outside edge towards first slip where Root dives to his right to take that one but it doesn't stick in his palms. It came at a good diving height too and should have been taken. The ball bursts through his palms and they take a single as well.
Shortish and outside off, steered behind point for a single.
Once again hits the deck hard on middle, Ravindra ducks to evade it.
Wide! Ball bangs in short on middle, Jadeja stays put in the crease as the ball goes well over him to the keeper.
Angles in a length ball on the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
Again a short ball for Jadeja. That seems to be the plan for Jadeja as it is two in two now. This was way down the leg side and Jadeja was quick to duck under it.
WELCOME JADEJA SAYS BROAD! NASTY FOR A FIRST BALL! It was dug in really short and the ball was climbing on Jadeja who sways away with a hop as the ball goes just past the throat to the keeper.
RAVINDRA JADEJA walks in next, replacing Ashwin!

OUT! THAT WAS BRILLIANT BY BUTTLER! Ashwin has to depart after a really well played knock of 67 runs. Broad bowls a back of a length delivery outside off, Ashwin tries to run it down towards third man but Buttler who was standing at gully dives low to his left to hold on to a stunner. That was a sensational catch as it was coming in quick and his reflexes was too fast there. There was a moment of silence there and the home ground lad is walking back.

Length ball outside off, Karun cuts it elegantly towards the sweeper cover for a single.
Dug in short but did not bounce as expected and Ashwin stays in his crease to nudge it towards fine leg for a single.
A bit short outside off, Karun stays tall in his crease to defend that one.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Karun square cuts it straight to the point fielder.

Again a short ball from Ball, Ashwin tries to pull it but the ball flies off his top edge and falls way short of the fine leg fielder for a single.
Again a short delivery and Karun successfully hits the ball towards the mid on region which is empty and they run three runs.
FOUR! HARD HIT ! Dug in short, Karun stays in his crease and smashes it down the ground towards mid on for a boundary.  Seemed like a tennis smash.
JAKE BALL will share the new ball with STUART BROAD.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Karun guides it towards the point fielder.
A long stop in place now... It's Root out there.
Dug in short, Ashwin pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Pitched outside off, Ashwin gets a leading edge towards point.
That ball was climbing on Ashwin. Back of a length ball outside off, Ashwin was shocked to see it closer to his face.
FOUR! SUBLIME! Angling across the batsmen, Ashwin cuts it really late through the point region for such a well timed boundary.
First ball up with the third new ball and Broad pitches it short into the body, Ashwin pulls it away towards mid-wicket.
Third new ball is also taken...
STUART BROAD is brought back in the attack!
Down the leg side, Ashwin nudges it towards fine leg for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Ashwin drives it towards the mid on region.
On the pads, Nair flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! THAT'S NAIR SPECIAL! Tossed up outside off, Nair camps back and punches it through extra cover for a boundary. That shot shows how high he is on confidence.
Dragged short into the pads, Ashwin flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Ashwin tries to drive it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Angling into the stumps, Nair gets an inside edge into the pads.
Ashwin reaches out to the ball to drive it through the cover region for a single.
Length ball outside off, Ashwin drives it through covers for a couple.
Again down the leg side, Nair nudges it towards fine leg for a single.
On the pads, Nair has flicked it towards mid-wicket.
KARUN NAIR is the third Indian to convert a maiden century into a double century.

FOUR! Nair has been sublime all throughout the day and has just showed his class as he reaches to his first double century, that is some feet! His ability to play such long innings is very well known in the domestic level but to convert that in the international circuit needs some caliber. That ball was pitched up outside off, Karun was quick to pounce into it and to drive it through covers for a boundary. Arms are aloft and he acknowledges the cheer from the crowd and his teammates.
JENNINGS comes in for a bowl.
Floated up outside off, Ashwin lunges forward with the ball.
Tossed up, Ashwin gets in line of the ball to defend it.
Outside off, Ashwin covers his stumps and tries to defend it but the ball is just a bit wide off the outside edge.
Short and outside off, Karun cuts it really late for a single through point.
Full toss outside off, Ashwin drives it down the ground towards mid on for  a single.
Short and down the leg side, Karun is quick to pounce on it and pull it towards square leg for a single.

So it's time for the final session of the day. The players are walking out in the middle. KARUN NAIR and ASHWIN will continue to impose with the bat. MOEEN ALI will start off with the ball for the visitors.
... DAY 4, SESSION 3 ...

England will be surely feeling the heat now. They have even asked Jennings to bowl but even that didn't work. On such kind of a track, you expect the bowling team to get toiled. The lead is swelling and so is this current partnership. How much more will India bat? Sunil Gavaskar in his pitch report mentioned that the ball will grip after the afternoon session, so let's wait and see if it really does. Will we see a declaration from the Indians? Join us back at 1430 IST for the final session.

Session highlights - 30 overs, 119 runs, 0 wicket! Another session bagged by the Indians as they have not only seen the session unscathed but have wiped out the deficit and also have gained a 105-run lead. Karun Nair has absolutely made his mind that he wants to score a double ton and has applied himself with sheer grit and authority in the middle. The local boy, Ravichandran Ashwin has once again proved, if he has an off day with the cherry, his willow will do the talking. He registered another Test fifty and survived a scare just at the stroke of Tea by making an excellent use of the review.
Fuller delivery outside off, Ash pushes it towards mid off. TEA ON DAY 4!
Short and wide outside off, Ash guides it towards point.
Back of a length on the off stump, defended solidly by Ashwin.
Outside off, left alone.

NOT OUT! Ashwin is safe and he can carry on with the bat. That was some excellent piece of review there after consulting with Karun. Angling into the stumps, Ashwin tries to clip it on the on side but is unable to make contact and the ball goes straight to hit the front pad. A loud appeal and the umpire obliges them by giving it out. After consultation, Ashwin goes for a review and the replays shows that the it was pitched in line and the impact was also in line. But the main thing which matters - it would have gone on to miss the stumps.
Ashwin is given out LBW but he opts for the review.
Ashwin gets an inside edge straight into his pads.
Nair gets in line of the ball and drives it through covers for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Nair prods forward to defend it.
Karun shuffles across and Moeen was quick to see that as he pushes the ball quicker down the leg side and Nair is no where near the ball. He is lucky that the ball did not the stumps.

Full outside off, Ashwin gets on the front foot and eases it down to long on for a single.

Slower one outside off, Nair stretches out to it to defend it straight down the ground.
Touch flatter and zipping through the surface, tucked towards square leg for another single.
Ashwin makes a good stride forward and pushes it towards covers. Wanted the single immediately and gets it easily in the end.
Loopy ball around off, gets back and keeps it out with a straight blade.
Goes back in the crease and smothers it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Nair gets down and across and reverse sweeps it but finds the man at backward point.
Floats it up around off, pushed off the front foot towards covers.
Good length ball on middle, defended with a straight bat.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Nair looks to cash in on the width that is on offer with a cut shot but ends up getting a bottom edge on it.
Once again it's hurled in the same zone, Ashwin creams it past covers for a single.
Fuller on off, driven straight to the man at short extra cover.
Very full and outside off, driven brilliantly through covers for a single.
Ali bowls a loopy ball outside off, it turns in sharply. Ashwin shuffles a bit to flick it on the leg side but gets a bit of gloves on it as the ball dies down.
Outside off, turning in, Ashwin looks to flick but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Gets back and flicks it through the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, Nair looks to play the reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the back foot.
10th fifty in Tests for RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN.

FOUR! There it is! Ashwin gets to his fifty! He had a tough time with the ball but covers it up with the bat and gives his home crowd something to cheer for. They are up to laud his effort. Jennings strays it on the pads, Ashwin couldn't have asked for anything better. He just clips it through backward square leg and the raise of the bat follows next.
Driven straight to the man at covers.
Fuller on off, driven towards covers.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Fuller on middle, pushed towards mid on.

A loud, loud shout for LBW! Jennings into the act straigthaway but it's turned down. Angles in a length delivery from over the wicket. It comes back in and raps Karun on the front pads. He turns back and appeals with a jump but the umpire shakes his head. Replays show it was in line but would have just clipped the stumps. So, the umpire's call would have stayed anyway. I remember a recent Day/Night game between South Africa and Australia in the latter's den, Temba Bavuma was asked to have a go with the ball and troubled Khawaja who was in his 90s in the similar manner.
England are trying everything to get a scalp here and now they have KEATON JENNINGS to have a go.
Full around middle and leg, flicked towards square leg for a single.
KN has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Short on middle, stays low as well, Nair gets back, adjusts it well to pull it through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Short around middle, turning away, gives ample of time to Nair to hit him. He obliges as he camps back in a jiffy and crunches it through covers for a boundary to start the over.
Around leg, Nair looks to help it on its way with a paddle sweep but fails to get going with the shot.
There is a mini break in the middle. Karun Nair is having a doze of medicine.

FOUR! Quality shot! Rashid drops it a bit short and outside off, Ashwin frees his arms. He gets back and cuts it through point for a boundary. Split the gap through a strong off side field. The local boy is inching closer to his Test fifty.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Loopy leg break around off, Ashwin gets down to play the sweep but is beaten as the ball turns away.
Floats it up around middle and off, Nair sweeps it in the air towards square leg for a single.

Tossed up and it's short around off, it's cut off the back foot towards point.

Full and outside leg, worked towards long on for a single.
Short and outside leg, punched through covers for a single.
Outside leg, turning in, Ashwin doesn't play at it and lets it hit his pads.
Outside leg and on the pads, Ash looks to flick but it goes off the pads towards short fine leg.
Flatter one around off, Karun shoulders his arms.
Full and around off, it's left alone.

They all go up in an appeal for a catch but the umpire stays unmoved. Then he asks them to cool down and asks the help from the TV umpire. Replays show there was no bat involved as the sound that came was off the willow hitting the ground.

Tosses it up outside leg, Ashwin comes forward and pads it away.
100-run stand between Ashwin and Karun!
Gets back and punches it down to long on for a single.
KN presses forward and blocks it out.
Outside leg, turning in, Nair pushes it off the back foot towards covers.
Pitched outside leg, Karun pads it away.
Short outside off, Ashwin cuts it late towards point.
Way wide outside off, left alone.
On the stumps, Karun sweeps it really well towards square leg for a single.
Short ball on the stumps, Karun punches it towards covers.
Outside off, Ash plays it really late towards point for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, Ashwin gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.

Nair camps back and defends it off his back foot.
Floated up, Nair prods forward to defend it.
Outside off, Ashwin drives it towards long off for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, Ashwin digs it out straight back to the bowler.
Pitched outside leg, Nair punches it towards mid-wicket for a single.
DRINKS has been taken.
Again a short delivery, Nair pulls it away through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL SHOT! Karun reaches out to the ball and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Nair cuts it late from outside off towards the point region.

Full outside off, Nair tries to reverse sweep it but is unable to make contact. There was an appeal but it looks like the bat hit the ground and the umpire sticks with not out. Replays now show that there was a faint edge there which was caught by Bairstow behind the stumps.
Way outside off, left alone.
Tossed outside off, Karun cuts it late towards the point fielder.
Tossed up outside off, Ash drives it towards covers.
Ashwin drives it towards covers.
Dragged a bit short, Ash goes back and defends it straight in front of his eyes.
Ashwin lunges forward to defend it.
THAT WAS CLOSE! Tossed up just outside off, Ashwin prods forward to defend it but the ball spins just away from the outside edge. That was pretty close.
Angled into the stumps from outside leg, Nair flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Finally a ball on the stumps, Ashwin camps back and defends it.
Pitched outside off, Ashwin tries to cut it but is unable to make contact.
Four leaves again, Way outside off.

Dawson and Broad bowled well but cramping the Indians for runs did not help them land a wicket. Stokes was the pick of the bowler's but was unlucky not to find a single wicket. Join us back in a while for the second session of the last Test.

A good session for the Indians as they have batted out really well losing just one wicket in the process. Vijay and Karun went about their business at a good pace till Dawson got the better of Vijay. Pitch Report - Sunil Gavaskar says a little bit more turn was seen last night when Moeen was bowling. Not a great difference in the pitch as it has not broken up and the Indian bowlers might take advantage of it as it might start breaking up later in the day. He adds that the pitch has not broken up as it was covered for long durations. He also opines that it is a difficult for a team to cheaply dismiss the opposition. He also mentions that Rahul would have thought of getting a triple hundred had he survived last night.

Good morning and a warm welcome on Day 4 of the final Test between India and England. The Indians are in a good position with the bat and they would love to impose themselves on the visitors. They would be wanting to bat out as long as possible and put a huge total on the board so that they don't need to bat again. The visitors on the other hand will try to get some quick wickets in the first hour of play and try to get a look at India's tail. It will be a really exciting day's play as both the teams will try to put up a better show. Join us in a while as live action isn't far away.

Ben Stokes bowled really well but he was under used by Cook and no other bowler imposed any trouble to the batsmen. India just trail by 86 runs and they have 6 wickets in hand. They will love to bat the whole day tomorrow and post a really good score so as to impose pressure once again on the visitors. The tourists will try to wrap up the Indians tomorrow as early as they can to hold a chance in the game. Join us tomorrow early morning for the fourth day which should be a really exciting days play at 0930 IST. Till then, cheers and take care.

England tried to impose the pressure as they got Pujara and then Kohli, the two mainstays of the Indian cricket out in real quick succession. They tried hard to create further inroads but they were totally undone by Rahul and Nair. The former kept on playing till nearly the end of the day but he got off just one short of his first double hundred. He would be really disappointed because of that but his fellow Karnataka player kept playing with the home town hero Vijay till stumps.

The breaks have haunted him quite some times in the series.

Pitch Report - Sunil Gavaskar says that this is the best batting surface of the series. No marks really except some bowlers' footmarks. He also adds that there is a bit of turn and says that the English bowlers need to bowl at the Indian lengths to be effective. He also reckons that this pitch is made so that the match lasts the five days as Chennai is hosting a Test match after a long break. He mentions that the pitch has remained compact and getting the ball to reverse will be difficult due to the lush green outfield.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the third day's play. The Chepauk surface has been very docile over the first two days and it has meant that patient batsmen can make it big.
